biotools.summary: TFEBexplorer is a web tool that provides an integrated platform to study genes regulated by the stress-responsive transcription factor EB (TFEB). It integrates multiple datasets, offering insights into gene expression changes and experimentally validated binding sites across different species and cell lines.
